Subset of the user-provided independent emf_wuji_retarget reference for wuji-sdk 2026.8.31.

Included: objectives.py, _numeric.py and prepare_targets excerpt in targets.py.
Source location and upstream/local SHA256 values are in SOURCE.json.
No SDK binaries, URDF assets, MANO preprocessing or nalgebra eigensolver are included.
The upstream nalgebra license is retained for provenance; its routines are not used here.
Other formulas were independently reconstructed in the user-provided project.
This is not an official Wuji SDK release and asserts no new license for upstream material.
